intro: Renato Gallina is an energetic barker found promoting business in Stormwind City's bustling Trade District. A member of the Gallina winemaking family, his job is to drum up patrons and direct thirsty travelers to the family winery nestled along the city canals.

p: Standing amidst the busy stalls of the Trade District, Renato Gallina spends his days calling out to passers-by, boldly proclaiming that his family sells the finest vintages in all of Stormwind. His family operates the Gallina Winery located nearby along the Canals, and Renato serves as their public promoter, handing out advertisements to anyone willing to help spread word of their cellar to thirsty travelers across the kingdom.
